fact: The article refers to Cameroon's customs system CAMCIS, whose interoperability with SYDONIA World is being examined by an AFRITAC-supported mission.
The Cameroon customs director general said the interconnection between CAMCIS and Chad's SYDONIA World remains a priority, naming CAMCIS as the system Cameroon customs uses.
Cameroon's Director General of Customs says the CAMCIS customs information system has been in operation since April 2020, with its freight, clearance and revenue-collection modules launched.

The GUCE single window, a partnership of the State and operators on a platform dating from 2012, is described as issuing customs duty receipts and clearing imports and vehicles within 48 hours; a third-generation version is announced for Q1 2025.
